_cue(&"focus_start" if _skill or def.mode in [WeaponDefinition.Mode.LASER,WeaponDefinition.Mode.SINGULARITY] else &"jump" if def.mode in [WeaponDefinition.Mode.SHURIKEN,WeaponDefinition.Mode.FAN,WeaponDefinition.Mode.BOOMERANG] else &"confirm")
GameAudio.cue(self, &"coin" if pickup.kind == "coin" else &"heal" if pickup.kind == "heart" else &"note")
check(music.request_track(&"home") and music.starts == started, "same-track request preserves actual playback")
check(not music.request_track(&"missing") and music.requested_track == &"home", "unknown track cannot replace current request")
check(music.request_track(&"home") and int(music.starts.get(&"home", 0)) == 1, "rapid return reuses still-playing original track without restart")
check(not app._music.request_track(&"forest_boss"), "late requests after shutdown cannot resurrect music")
check(audio.play(id) and count_cue(id) == 1, "actual pool accepts and counts " + str(id))
check(not audio.play(&"note") and count_cue(&"note") == 0, "thirteenth simultaneous cue is dropped without count")
check(not audio.play(&"forest_wind"), "service rejects a new regional world voice while paused")
check(audio.play(&"click"), "same paused service still accepts original UI click")
check(audio.play(&"victory"), "selective stop fixture starts an actual original cue")
for id: StringName in GameAudio.REGIONAL_CUE_PATHS: check(audio.play(id), "selective stop fixture starts " + str(id))
check(not audio._shutting_down and audio.play(&"roar"), "regional stop leaves service active for original cues")
check(audio.play(&"bell"), "Real audio service starts an owned voice")
check(not audio.play(&"click"), "repeated same-frame click does not overlap")
check(not audio.play(&"jump"), "zero volume cannot create a voice")
check(not app.motion_audio.motion_cue(&"heavy",1,actor.get_instance_id()) and app.motion_audio.motion_events.size()==event_count,"mute admits no new motion voice")
